entries.title: CDISC CORE published conformance rules (reference CSV)
entries.verifiedHow: Cloned and read on 2026-10-17: 823 published rules with descriptions and citations.
entries.note: Not fetched by the app. Build the CSV with scripts/build_core_rules_reference.py, or use the ready-made pack, then upload it (scope global, type standard).

entries.title: CDISC foundational standards: SDTMIG, CDASHIG, ADaMIG, Define-XML, SDTM model
entries.verifiedHow: Landing page only. The exact file links were not checked.
entries.licence: CDISC terms apply. Whether a download needs a free account or membership is not confirmed here.
entries.note: Download the versions your studies use (for example SDTMIG 3.4), then upload with the version filled in.

entries.title: CDISC Therapeutic Area User Guides (TAUGs)
entries.verifiedHow: Link given on the NCI CDISC Terminology page. Page not opened.
entries.note: One guide per area (oncology, diabetes, and so on). Download the areas you work in and upload each at TA scope with the area name.

entries.title: FDA Study Data Technical Conformance Guide and Data Standards Catalog
entries.verifiedHow: No link verified. Search the FDA site for the guide's title; it is updated about twice a year.
entries.note: Which standard versions FDA accepts. Take the current version.

entries.title: PMDA Technical Conformance Guide on Electronic Study Data Submissions
entries.verifiedHow: No link verified. Only needed for Japan submissions.

entries.title: Pinnacle 21 validation rules documentation
entries.verifiedHow: No link verified. Community edition documents are usually behind a login.

entries.title: Veeva Vault CDMS help and CQL reference
entries.verifiedHow: Vendor documentation sits behind a customer login. Not reachable without it.
entries.licence: Vendor terms. Your agreement decides what you may store.
entries.note: Highest value for the CQL path. Export from your own Veeva access, then upload at global scope for the Veeva EDC.

entries.title: Open EDC documentation (REDCap, OpenClinica)
